text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —Hell yeah!! Awesome! I set a new record!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh... Well done, bearer of an 
innocent soul.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Just as I foresaw... You have overcome the 
twelve trials and attained a formidable 
physique...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! Heheh! It's all thanks 
to you, Guim-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Doing what you told me made me this 
strong! Gimlet-senpai, you really are 
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...No, every lesson I have imparted to you 
is a covenant with the North Star that 
guides me.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Just as the world's guardian listens to 
all sounds across the earth, working with 
less sleep than a bird, there is someone 
who constantly watches over and supports 
me...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa! That guy's that awesome!? Is he 
Gimlet-senpai's... underling? Wait, a 
pal!?"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Wrong. She is one of the few who 
understands me. One could even call her my 
one and only accomplice, willing to make 
an enemy of the entire world.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Those who equally seek the fleeting 
moment, crave destruction, and take on the 
race...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: In a race...? Ah! You mean the Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I see~! You're giving them some great 
guidance! That's so cool! I can really 
feel the passionate bond!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... 'Bonds', is it...? Indeed, 
we must be bound by the chains of destiny.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"I will guide that one to the promised 
land that lies beyond destruction. Until 
the day we arrive... I will never let go 
of that hand...!"
